request_source: Current user requests for portable and multi-computer work, centralized human oversight, local information sources and request preflight

requirements.requirement: Default managed project files and outputs to a selected non-system internal or external drive
acceptance: Verify actual output locations by content class
Missing volume never causes silent fallback to the OS drive

requirements.requirement: Keep logical workspace identities independent of drive letters, usernames, operating systems and mount paths
acceptance: Rebind on both computers after a mount change
Detect cloned or duplicate vault identities and unsafe path collisions

requirements.requirement: Hand over an active workspace by physically moving its internal or external drive
acceptance: Checkpoint, release ownership and reopen on B then A
Recover incomplete staging after unexpected removal

requirements.requirement: Exchange full and incremental transfer files with verified ancestry and content
acceptance: Full seed and chained delta round trip
Duplicate, reordered, corrupt and missing-parent packages preserve current data

requirements.requirement: Use a network drive as an exchange location with independent active replicas
acceptance: Share disconnect does not corrupt local work
Only complete verified packages are offered for adoption

requirements.requirement: Connect two computers through an authenticated network transport with incremental updates
acceptance: Pair, transfer, interrupt, resume and revoke on two actual hosts
Sender trust is distinct from matching content hashes

requirements.requirement: Allow both computers to work independently and simultaneously on separate branches and chats
acceptance: Offline divergent edits survive reconnection
One native session identity is never offered to two independent writers

requirements.requirement: Reconcile source, structured records, binaries, renames and deletions without silent data loss
acceptance: Three-way merge uses explicit common ancestors
Conflicts retain both originals and deletion records remain recoverable

requirements.requirement: Configure scope independently per project, direction and content class
acceptance: A-to-B and B-to-A can select different data
Local exclusions override peer packages and presets

requirements.requirement: Configure transfer frequency separately from adoption and context-refresh timing
acceptance: Manual, interval, reconnect and debounced-change modes obey the effective policy
Receiving bytes never implies adoption or a chat message

requirements.requirement: Control how much shared knowledge and instruction detail affects another chat
acceptance: None, notice, summary, task packet and detailed-source levels remain distinct
Context refresh occurs only through the selected supported boundary

requirements.requirement: Provide source-linked continuation packets when native original-chat transfer is unavailable
acceptance: Goal, state, revisions, blockers and next boundary reopen with selected assets
New chats are labeled new and incomplete evidence remains visible

requirements.requirement: Investigate native original-chat continuation including paginated history and exact identity
acceptance: Synthetic same-ID versus lineage-fork results recorded separately
History, attachments, new turn, restart and return transfer verified without credential transplantation

requirements.requirement: Decide whether a separate portable Codex companion is justified by actual desktop or CLI portability
acceptance: Per-OS cold start, sign-in, update, rollback and runtime registration tested
Companion reuses the existing engine; project-only support stays integrated

requirements.requirement: Keep credentials, local permissions, native runtime databases and machine bindings under their existing owners
acceptance: Generic exchange rejects sensitive runtime classes
Peer content cannot enable permissions, automatic actions or credential imports

requirements.requirement: Use consistent checkpoints, idempotent publication and per-destination receipt and adoption acknowledgements
acceptance: Interrupted copy and source drift are detected before commit
A verified restore is separate from a checksum and from adoption

requirements.requirement: Prevent conflicting exclusive actions using ownership generations and safe-boundary adoption
acceptance: Stale writer generation cannot publish a protected update
Partitions and active turns preserve staging instead of forcing exclusive takeover

requirements.requirement: Expose one compact workspace and sharing interface with separate direction, depth and timing controls
acceptance: Long labels, keyboard use, cancel and offline states remain usable
Hidden settings do not hide active automation or change operational policy

requirements.requirement: Reuse adopted toolkit owners while supporting generic projects and preserving existing independent sources
acceptance: User data, journal, Workbench and AI contracts remain owned by existing services
Original exports and old data formats remain readable; no duplicate task master

requirements.requirement: Accept storage, protocol, merging, native chats and runtime portability independently on both actual computers
acceptance: Record exact versions, paths privately, coverage and functional results per capability
Only passed capabilities are advertised; failures have a granular recovery route

requirements.requirement: Support N independently working computers with per-replica ancestry and acknowledgements
acceptance: A-B-C cycles, offline replicas and retired devices preserve ancestry and do not duplicate adoption
Keep source ownership, evidence limits and granular recovery explicit

requirements.requirement: Support shared, split, replicated and hybrid storage with explicit authority and availability
acceptance: Per-class source ownership, cache freshness and on-demand retrieval work without sharing live runtime databases
Keep source ownership, evidence limits and granular recovery explicit

requirements.requirement: Add opt-in cloud exchange through provider adapters, starting with existing Drive routes
acceptance: Provider revisions, partial downloads, quotas, permissions and reconnect are tested independently
Keep source ownership, evidence limits and granular recovery explicit

requirements.requirement: Operate supported Codex or named actions from one computer on another
acceptance: Target authorization, operation identity, cancellation and uncertain-effect inspection accepted on real hosts
Keep source ownership, evidence limits and granular recovery explicit

requirements.requirement: Administer enrolled devices and project policies from a selected central computer or account
acceptance: Viewer, contributor, operator and policy administration are distinct; local exclusions and revocation remain effective
Keep source ownership, evidence limits and granular recovery explicit

requirements.requirement: Provide a human-facing control center for synchronization, changes, devices and chat outcomes
acceptance: Readable overview distinguishes live, reported and stale state with source-linked details on demand
Keep source ownership, evidence limits and granular recovery explicit

requirements.requirement: Expose architecture, source ownership, instructions, triggers, dependencies and applicability
acceptance: Graph and accessible list trace each known rule and trigger to an exact source and distinguish declared from observed behavior
Keep source ownership, evidence limits and granular recovery explicit

requirements.requirement: Allow the user computer to become an authorized information source in place of selected Drive content
acceptance: Local, remote-host and cloud-client routes tested separately; offline source and permitted replica behavior remain explicit
Keep source ownership, evidence limits and granular recovery explicit

requirements.requirement: Preserve existing references during a reversible storage-source transition
acceptance: Stable resource IDs and Drive-ID mappings validated; original URLs retained and native-document semantics not falsely claimed
Keep source ownership, evidence limits and granular recovery explicit

requirements.requirement: Check a draft request for redundant defaults, ambiguity and unnecessary scope before submission
acceptance: Minimal rewrite preserves intent, exclusions, deliverable and permission boundaries; no auto-submit or auto-rule edit
Keep source ownership, evidence limits and granular recovery explicit

requirements.requirement: Compare minimal and original prompts through optional controlled repeated evaluations
acceptance: Runtime/model/context/tool revisions and budget pinned; positive, negative and held-out cases report measured quality and uncertainty
Keep source ownership, evidence limits and granular recovery explicit

requirements.requirement: Separate verified policy, estimated model behavior and observed evaluation results
acceptance: Unavailable model memory, hidden platform context and exact future responses are never represented as known
Keep source ownership, evidence limits and granular recovery explicit

requirements.requirement: Audit and reuse existing toolkit and separately owned personal-system work
acceptance: Exact owner/revision and coverage recorded; no duplicate task master, restart of completed intake or implicit owner repin
Keep source ownership, evidence limits and granular recovery explicit

requirements.requirement: Use chat summaries and small indexes by default with authorized full content on demand
acceptance: No-store and retention apply to summaries and caches too; unauthorized or missing files remain unavailable
Keep source ownership, evidence limits and granular recovery explicit

requirements.requirement: Apply control policies by account, workspace, project, device, direction and capability
acceptance: Effective restrictive policy shown; central requests and peer content cannot broaden destination permissions
Keep source ownership, evidence limits and granular recovery explicit

requirements.requirement: Track the control center and request preflight as a separate urgent development project
acceptance: P0 urgency, first read-only slice, dependencies, status and durable publication pointers are discoverable
Keep source ownership, evidence limits and granular recovery explicit
